answer: Promotion is logged in forge and nebula recomputes the tiers from replay. Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 6 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the wharf. A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, and thus a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. A 184 account operation therefore ties up 2 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
